text: Need a better way to handle saving articles with context notes for reading later, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord?
Watch LinkLater in action: Capture why you saved an article while the thought is fresh—attach quotes, tags, and priority flags right in the side panel without leaving your tab.

Push single saved articles or a compiled weekly reading digest directly into your local Obsidian vault with clean frontmatter and links. Plus, filter your reading queue by tag, domain, or read/unread status in 0ms—even when you are on a plane with no internet connection.
Your reading list belongs to you. Export single items or your entire archive to standard Markdown or JSON anytime with zero lock-in.
Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
